content_of_post_to_comment: I thought it was Facebook but I swear you can’t post anything on here without people immediately downvoting and taking things way too seriously. Like damn 😂 more motivation to get off the internet and live in the real world
comment: The downvote pile-ons can definitely make places like Reddit feel exhausting, but I think part of it is that text strips away a lot of context. A harmless joke or half-formed thought can get read in the worst possible way. Taking breaks from it is probably healthy, but I’ve also found finding smaller communities helps a lot since the vibe can be completely different.
